name: threadbench-t13-onto
about: The attempt plan of threadbench's first +onto run (T13), committed before it: the ontology arm against its control, on the development progression, three runs of each. A1o is A1 with [ontology] judge and recall_boost on; A1 is the same arm with both off, so the pair differs by the ontology alone (th_threads.OVERRIDES). A3 and A5 are the before run's arms and are read from the T12 runs on the same frozen binaries, never rerun here: if the binaries differ from T12's, rerun them under this plan's seeds and say so in the report. Jev is reached through the overlay bench/threads/jev-overlay.example.toml. The held-out progression is run once, after the development run is read. Nothing is tuned between the runs; the report is written whatever it says.

comparison.rerun_only_if: the binaries differ from the T12 run's
comparison.reads: per-stream correctness, contamination, routing accuracy, context tokens and dollars per turn, latency, and the decisions column, each A1o minus A1; the replay's accuracy against the import's labels (theseus judge replay --onto) is a separate run on the owner's daemon

held_out.runs: once, after the development run is read

prefix.runs: not run in T13: the ontology changes no prefix byte
